summary: Revelation Biosciences filed an 8-K announcing the adoption of a stockholder rights plan (poison pill). The board declared a dividend of one preferred share purchase Right per share of common stock, exercisable at $20.00 per one-thousandth of a share of Series B Junior Participating Preferred Stock. The plan triggers if a person or group acquires 10% beneficial ownership (15% for passive investors) without board approval. Upon triggering, flip-in provisions allow other holders to purchase common stock at half market value. The plan aims to prevent hostile takeovers. Watch for shareholder activism or potential acquisition interest as the pill deters accumulators.
